breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the axial deformation integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx with the actual varying area A(x), without replacing it with an arithmetic mean area. The incorrect instruction to substitute the arithmetic mean area and treat it as exact has been removed, matching the ground truth prompt.
